tasks.question: How do retrieval-augmented generators handle temporal knowledge drift?

duplicate_max_derivation.rationale: C18/D.7 re-derivation after wiring true duplicate_ratio() (formerly rejected_ratio() == 0.0); offline deterministic fake corpus exhibits 0.833-0.842 quote duplication across all 17 tasks.
